page0.text:
A slash.
Saber sinks into the ground, all the way to her ankles, as she parries a massive blow.
The parrying blade is swift, but heavy.
The axe-sword strikes down from overhead.
The brutally powerful weapon grazes Saber's armor as she dodges, then tears up the earth itself.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page0:1

page1.text:
"Nnngggh!"
My jaw is clenched so hard my teeth could well shatter.
Is there really nothing I can do?
I can't protect Saber. I can't fight alongside her.
There's nothing I can do.
All I can do is...
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page1:1

page2.text:
"Then at least imagine it.
It's all you can really do."
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page2:1

page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page3:1

page4.text: You don't need an enemy. The only opponent you need to fight is your own mind.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page4:1

page5.text:
Yeah. What was he saying, again? It wasn't one of his typical snide remarks. What he said had weight and importance to it...and I needed to understand.
Then again...
Probably everything he told me was a warning I shouldn't ignore.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page5:1

page6.text:
Saber goes flying.
This time it's not because she leaped away to evade.
Berserker hit her this time.
That hurricane slash strikes Saber in the side.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page6:1

page7.text:
She stumbles.
Coughing violently, she grips her weapon tighter and turns back toward Berserker.
The giant doesn't miss the opening Saber finally provides.
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page7:1

page8.text:
"S...top!"
My voice doesn't reach them.
Shouting is useless, and trying to use the bow like Archer would be pointless.
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page8:1

page9.text:
Don't I understand yet?
What can I do?
What should these hands of mine be doing?
That's right.
What do I need to save Saber?
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page9:1

page10.text:
I can't use a bow. A spear won't pierce him. Having a weapon just like the enemy's is no solution either.
To go up against that giant...
...a sword to cut through a mountain of stone.
An opulent sword...sharper than sharp...that will never dull... A king's sword, able to cut down enemies in a single blow...
Like...
...that golden sword I saw in my dream... A sword fit for her.
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page10:1

page11.text:
"Kngh...!"
My head hurts.
I try to fight down my nausea, but I never take my eyes off Saber.
Strangely, the longer I watch Saber fall, the more this indescribable pain assaults me.
Saber and Berserker seem to be moving in slow motion.
I see a row of switches line up.
Saber coughs, and for a brief second she arches in pain.
Berserker smashes his axe-sword down toward her with all his might.
It's as if there's a row of nails in need of hammering down.
It's like he's knocking down dominoes.
The switch flips.
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page11:1

page12.text:
"Saber!"
Berserker's axe-sword cuts Saber down.
She's going to die.
The strike splits Saber in half at the waist, and pieces of her flesh go flying.
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page12:1

page13.text:
"No...that's not what's happening!"
The only thing that's gone flying is pieces of armor.
Berserker's only split Saber's armor.
Saber left herself open to bait Berserker into a single, huge swing...and with every ounce of strength she has, she rushes at him.
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page13:1

page14.text:
!
A black roar rips through the air.
But he can't escape now. Saber's right in front of him.
She shifts her grip on her sword and darts in closer, then swings with all her might!
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page14:1

page15.text:
I don't believe this.
Saber's attack hits home and the giant, who had seemed so immovable, flies back several meters.
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page15:1

page16.text:
And then...
"Get back, Saber!"
Then comes the true attack.
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page16:1

page17.text:
She must intend to release the attack from as close as possible.
Tohsaka jumps down from the branch above and throws her jewels at Berserker as she falls...
"Neun, acht, sieben...!
Stil, schießt ErschieSsung!
Shards of ice rain on Berserker.
Among those shards are three giant, spear-shaped icicles, each packed with enough magical energy to blow an entire mansion to smithereens!
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page17:1

page18.text:
"No, dodge it, Berserker!"
Illya, quiet until now, suddenly screams at her Servant.
She must have sensed the danger, but too late.
The ice spears aren't falling.
They're accelerating toward Berserker.
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page18:1

page19.text:
He can't possibly dodge.
A one-in-a-million opportunity... Saber's desperate attack perfectly coordinated with the ice bullet attacks.
It has more than enough magical energy to kill Berserker.
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page19:1

page20.text:
However...
!!!
The axe-sword slices through the air.
Even as Saber drives him back, he switches to a single-handed grip on his axe-sword and shatters all three ice spears.
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page20:1

page21.text:
Blood splatters the clearing.
Maybe it's his one-armed swing, but he fails to completely destroy the ice, and when it strikes, it severs one of Berserker's arms.
That's not all.
The ice freezes over Berserker's arm, completely restraining it.
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page21:1

page22.text:
But it only got one arm.
"Wha...!"
Saber cries out.
It's a reasonable response.
Berserker catches Tohsaka with his good arm as she falls.
page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page22:1

page23.text:
"Guh...!"
Tohsaka's face twists in pain.
Berserker will have no trouble crushing Tohsaka with his hand.
page23.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page23:1

page24.text:
"T-TOHSAKA!!!"
I run.
I don't care if I drag them down.
It doesn't matter if I can't do anything.
I'm not going to let Tohsaka die!
page24.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page24:1

page25.text:
"Rin!"
Saber must be too weak to even stand, but somehow she gets to her feet.
"..."
Tohsaka must be in agonizing pain, but she stretches a hand out as she hangs her head downward.
And then...
page25.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page25:1

page26.text:
"Heh. Just as I thought."
She grins wickedly.
page26.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page26:1

page27.text:
"Gh—!?"
Everyone gasps.
Saber, me, and even Berserker must have all frozen in our tracks.
One person can only have so many tricks up their sleeve.
She knew this might happen, and she hadn't even bothered to tell us!
page27.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page27:1

page28.text:
!
Berserker squeezes harder around her.
He's a heartbeat too late.
"Got you!"
page28.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page28:1

page29.text:
Four bullets of pure light streak toward Berserker.
Four bullets. Four gems.
Four rapid shots at the most extreme close range... That has to be enough to end the dark, mad warrior.
page29.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page29:1

page30.text:
Or rather...
The attack perfectly, completely snuffs out his life.
page30.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page30:1

page31.text:
It must have blown Berserker's head clean off.
The blood splatter even reaches me, ten meters from where Berserker stands.
page31.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page31:1

page32.text:
There's...kind of a lot more than blood in the mess, but I don't think she overdid it.
Our opponent was a monster.
Berserker would have crushed Tohsaka if she hadn't blown his head off.
page32.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page32:1

page33.text:
"Phew..."
I slow my frantic run.
Tohsaka is still in Berserker's grip, but the battle's over.
Berserker's face is still hidden in a plume of smoke.
From that singing sound, it must have been a hell of an explo—
page33.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page33:1

page34.text:
"No way."
I hear Tohsaka's voice.
She's looking at the smoke in disbelief.
page34.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page34:1

page35.text:
Hold on.
Am I imagining things?
Did Berserker's hand tighten on Tohsaka?
page35.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page35:1

page36.text:
...
Tohsaka's staring at the plume of smoke.
It doesn't last long.
The smoke starts to dissipate.
And in the clearing air...
...Berserker's face—the face that should've been blown off his body—appears.
page36.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page36:1

page37.text:
"Ah..."
Tohsaka cowers under that evil demon's gaze, at a loss for words.
"Fufu. Ufufu. Ahahahaha!"
Laughter fills the air.
Illya, who's remained at the far side of the clearing, laughs delightedly.
page37.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page37:1

page38.text:
"I see you in a new light, Rin. I didn't think you could have possibly killed Berserker, even once.
But too bad. Berserker won't disappear that easily. You see, he can't die unless he's killed twelve times."
page38.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page38:1

page39.text:
"Killed...twelve times?"
She must have figured something out from what Illya just told her.
Tohsaka looks aghast, her face twisting in regret.
page39.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page39:1

page40.text:
"I...get it.
I should've figured it out as soon as I learned his True Name. Heracles should have the bow of Hydra, but his only weapon was a rock.
His Noble Phantasm isn't an object he's carrying. The symbol for the hero Heracles is—"
page40.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page40:1

page41.text:
"That's right. His body itself is his Noble Phantasm.
You should know about Heracles's twelve labors. The Greek hero Heracles overcame twelve monumental tasks to atone for his sins, and his reward was immortality.
You know exactly what that means, don't you?"
"A stockpile of lives...layers of resurrection magecraft."
page41.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page41:1

page42.text:
"Yep. That's why he can't die easily. He possesses the curse of immortality given by the gods so that he can endure the same number of trials, or deaths, he once overcame.
That's my Berserker's Noble Phantasm: God Hand."
page42.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page42:1

page43.text:
"Understand? You killed Berserker there, but he still has five lives left.
Fufu. You were so close, Rin. Berserker would have disappeared if you'd only used five times the jewels you just did."
page43.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page43:1

page44.text:
I can't hear Illya's voice clearly.
From the corner of my eye, I see Saber charging Berserker.
page44.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page44:1

page45.text:
"Rin, run!"
Saber dashes over.
Tohsaka tries to pry open Berserker's fingers, but they won't budge.
And then...
page45.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page45:1

page46.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page46:1

page47.text:
The burning eyes glare at Tohsaka.
"Ah...kyAAAAAAAAAAAAHHH!"
Tohsaka screams.
Berserker's enormous fingers dig into Tohsaka, trying to rip out her insides.
There's only one outcome...
...Tohsaka's lifeless body being crushed to nothing.
page47.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page47:1

page48.text:
...
I run.
I forget who I'm up against. I even forget where I am.
My mind is completely burned out.
page48.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page48:1

page49.text:
"I will not allow it!"
Saber cuts towards Berserker.
Her invisible sword swings at Berserker's defenseless arm, as if slicing through a radish.
But it's no use.
page49.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page49:1

page50.text:
Saber's attack pings harmlessly off of Berserker's arm. His grip on Tohsaka doesn't loosen.
"Gh—!?"
Just moving must be agony for Saber.
She swings her sword desperately, blood trickling from her mouth.
page50.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page50:1

page51.text:
"Wha...Shirou!?"
She freezes the instant she sees me rushing at Berserker.
page51.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page51:1

page52.text:
"Let go of her, you bastard!"
I slap mindlessly at his back with my bow.
The giant is unfazed.
He doesn't consider me a threat.
page52.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page52:1

page53.text:
"Guh...!"
My fingers are getting numb.
What the hell is he, if I'm the one going numb from hitting him?
page53.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page53:1

page54.text:
"Run, Shirou!"
Eh?
I look up when I hear Saber.
In that instant...
I go flying through the air like a leaf.
page54.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page54:1

page55.text:
"...Gah."
I hit the ground and tumble like a bit of stray garbage.
Berserker smacked me away with that frozen sword.
I try to block the attack with my bow, but it shatters instantly and I'm thrown so...far...away...
page55.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page55:1

page56.text:
"Gah...ah...ha...!!!"
I writhe in pain.
That breaking sound hadn't come from the bow.
One of my arms is bent at the wrong angle...in the wrong spot.
When I breathe in, my lungs hurt so bad I want to puke them up.
page56.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page56:1

page57.text:
"Ha...ah...goh...!"
I can't breathe properly with all the blood flooding my mouth.
But that doesn't matter.
Breathing will just make me pass out.
Better that I not breathe.
page57.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page57:1

page58.text:
"Ha...hah...ha...!"
I wake up.
Right now, I need to get to him...him...!
page58.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page58:1

page59.text:
I run.
It's my turn. I'm going to break his arm and save Tohsaka.
He must have eyes in the back of his head. He swings his sword casually, like he's batting aside a fly.
page59.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page59:1

page60.text:
I can dodge it.
I won't let an arm that's completely frozen hit me so easily!
page60.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page60:1

page61.text:
"Ha...!"
Damn...my body's sinking...!
He must have grazed my leg. Damn him! He didn't even touch my leg, but he somehow managed to break it anyway!
page61.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page61:1

page62.text:
"Ridiculous! That is enough. Stay back, Master!"
I can't do that.
I can't let Tohsaka die.
What do I need to do to save her?
page62.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page62:1

page63.text:
A weapon. A blade would be best. At my feet, broken pieces of the bow. Above me, Berserker's sword swinging right at me. There's no time to think. I let magical energy flow through me.
The Strengthening succeeds easily, but down comes Berserker's sword. The fragments are completely, finally pulverized. I meant to dodge, but instead my body slams to the ground. Clearly there was no point Strengthening broken shards. I'll have to do this from scratch.
It shouldn't be impossible. Anyone can imitate, as long as they have an example to follow. I just need to duplicate the foundation, structure, work, experience, time, and...
page63.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page63:1

page64.text:
The giant turns around.
It must have decided to kill the little nuisance before finishing Tohsaka off.
page64.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page64:1

page65.text:
...
I push up from the ground and glare at the giant.
There's no fear. I'm too burned out for fear.
But behind me...
page65.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page65:1

page66.text:
I see someone prepared to disappear.
I see someone determined to use the sacred sword.
page66.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-12:page66:1
